phrase: medieval mystery plays focused on the representation of bible stories in churches as tableaux with accompanying antiphonal song. they developed from the 10th to the 16th century, reaching the height of their popularity in the 15th century before being rendered obsolete by the rise of professional theatre. 19th-century engraving of a performance from the chester mystery play cycle there are four complete or nearly complete extant english biblical collections of plays from the late medieval period. the most complete is the york cycle of 48 pageants.
